meaning: A handheld camera that records video with sound onto tape or a card. Families used it to film birthdays and trips.
clues: It was handheld and made just for recording video, so you could film away from a computer.
Families used it at birthdays, school plays, and vacations.
Early ones used small video tapes, and you watched them on a TV.
It is one word made from "camera" and "recorder" joined together.
assumes: A webcam is a small camera that sends live video from a computer
A baby monitor lets you watch or hear a baby in another room
A digital camera mostly takes still photos

decoys.meaning: A small camera on or near a computer that sends live video.
A device that lets parents watch or hear a baby from another room.
A camera that saves photos to a memory card instead of film.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Dad filmed every birthday on one. The tapes are in a closet, and nobody has a player.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Today's version: your phone's camera. Tip: hold the phone sideways and steady, and your videos will look great.
